goal: Produce two parity-controlled production-quality Companion finalists for R7-01 without drifting into generic mascot, animal, human, robot, orb, or logo-only forms.

parity.camera: orthographic-like product character study; no dramatic perspective
parity.lighting: soft neutral studio lighting; no colored rim light
parity.material: matte soft-touch synthetic material; no fur, cloth, glass, chrome, or glossy toy finish
parity.text_policy: candidate code and tiny view labels only; no marketing copy
parity.emotion_policy: emotion must come from whole-form orientation, tension, compression, spacing, or internal structural alignment; not conventional face acting
parity.runtime_translation: must be plausible for vector/CustomPaint/Rive-style implementation

shared_hard_fails: arms, hands, legs, feet, ears, tail, hair, clothing, hat, glasses or props
continuous particles, glow, sparks or aura

D.name: D/Knot
positive_identity: single living interlaced structure formed from two broad continuous ribbons
clear over-under knot logic and deliberate negative space
attention expressed by two or three body-integrated structural apertures or tension points, never eyes
recognizable silhouette even as a solid black shape
not circular overall; avoid flower, petal, cloud and pretzel readings
D.f0_geometry: Build the silhouette from one coherent interlaced knot body. The body must read as a responsive presence rather than a logo, but contain no head, torso, limbs or face. Use asymmetry and directional tension to imply attention.

E.name: E/Tilt
positive_identity: single upright directional body with a clear forward tilt
one integrated folded facet or structural notch establishes orientation
composed, intentional, coach-like presence without humanoid posture
body-integrated directional hierarchy; no floating marker
strong vertical silhouette materially distinct from D/Knot
recognizable as a solid black shape at small size
not loop-based, not orb-based, not a rounded blob
E.f0_geometry: Build the silhouette as one upright tilted body with an integrated directional facet. The identity must come from the whole-body orientation. No detached topper, tab, badge, antenna, head, limbs or face.
